build_dataloader_from_args: build a dataloader from DataArgs config to load and tokenize JSONL dataset chunks for training
init_dataloader_state_from_args: initialize the prefetch state from DataArgs for a given rank and world size in distributed training
read_jsonl: create an iterator that reads lines from a JSONL file with configurable block size and offset for distributed reading
pack_tokens: build an iterator that packs token sequences into fixed-length chunks with multiple shifted views for teacher forcing
async_iterator: create an async producer-consumer iterator that prefetches data batches in a separate multiprocessing worker
